violations.text: Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Chemical names were applied to bottles at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

The garage door to the outside, located in the back storage area, is not tight-fitting (gap at the base door seal). Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. (Per the owner, adjustment to locking mechanism to be made to allow for tight closing of door.) New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026

Small Cups are being used as scoops in food items. Scoops with handles to be acquired and must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. Cups were removed at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026
The floor in the back storage area was observed in need of repair (floor tiles observed chipped/broken). Floor is to be repaired. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2027
